newsitem.title: THAILAND: Eight Thai finance firms apply for forex licences.
newsitem.headline: Eight Thai finance firms apply for forex licences.

text.p: Eight local finance companies have applied for licences to engage in the foreign exchange business, a Bank of Thailand (BOT) official said on Tuesday.

The BOT will examine the applicants' qualifications and forward them to the finance ministry for final approval, said Nongnart Sondysuwan, deputy director of the BOT's Financial Institutions Supervision and Development Department.
The central bank recently invited applications from finance companies for licences to deal in foreign exchange and the deadline for applications closed on Monday, she told reporters.

Applicants are Finance One Plc, Nithipat Capital Plc, National Finance and Securities Plc, Nava Finance and Securities Plc, SCF Finance and Securities Plc, Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc, First City Investment Plc and Thana One Finance and Securities Plc, she said.
Under current Thai regulations, only commercial banks are permitted to engage in the foreign exchange business.
